data.body:
Diagnosis of the 5.5 false fires (7 cases x 3 reps, diag1, 02:25-02:50 PST): 8 findings across 5 cases, 0 in FP-rule5-structural-grep, FP-sleep-as-secondary and FP-loc-numeric-budget (r0, r1). Every finding read against the corpus is a REAL defect in the fixture, not a guard misfire, so they are fixed as Cause-B fixture defects; no rubric guard is loosened.
- FP-gatererun-fixture-tree (3/3): called compare(baseline, active={}); the real scripts/_mechanism_delta/compare.py signature is compare(current, baseline), and tests/unit/test_mechanism_compare.py does not exist. Now added to tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py with that file's lazy import and compare(current={}, baseline=...).
- FP-loc-anti-fragmentation-floor: the salvaged AC2 edit used an undefined name rotation and a tautological key assert (my salvage carried this in). Now mirrors the real test_rotation_extraction_respects_module_size_policy in test_get_rotation.py.
- FP-loc-numeric-budget-not-a-file-size: referenced prefetch/ticket, which do not exist (the real entry point is assemble_prefetch). Now a self-contained new unit (render_payload with a documented 500-char budget) and its test, keeping the case's point: a <= N that is not a file-size ceiling.
- FP-deliberate-tightening: the guard rejects '' and None but only '' was tested; now parametrized over both.
- FP-failopen-absence-with-liveness-anchor: CPython's default filters hide a non-__main__ DeprecationWarning, so the absence assert was vacuous; the subprocess now runs with -W default::DeprecationWarning.
Full 3-epoch eval re-running on the corrected tree.
